release: 1 Timothy 6:15 — divine-pronoun and sovereign-title residual correction

rows.before: which in its own times he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings, and Master of masters;
rows.after: which God will show at the proper time—God, the blessed and only Ruler, the Sovereign of sovereigns, and Master of masters;
rows.reason: Context 1 Timothy 6:13–16: God (not Messiah Yeshua) is the one who reveals Yeshua's appearing at the proper time and is described as the blessed sole Ruler. Recast unmistakable God-referent he as God; following existing Way Version policy replace the divine title King of kings with Sovereign of sovereigns. Preserve the distinct human/messianic King titles elsewhere; render Greek basileus basileōn with explicit translation-equivalent paraphrase, not a claim it literally says Greek sovereign.

postReviewNotes: Second exact release after 45-verse NT divine-pronoun batch, resulting in 46 changed NT verses across the two sequential releases. No other Bible text is authorized.
